definitions: A congenital malformation characterized by the absence of all or part of one or more central digits of the hand or foot.
A condition where the hand or foot is cleft due to the absence of central digits, often resembling a lobster claw.
examples: The child was born with ectrodactyly.
Ectrodactyly can affect both hands and feet.
Genetic counseling was offered due to the family history of ectrodactyly.
